narrative: The foot of the leaf. The last sentence is dry. Bare paper under it, the same bare paper as at ten. The pen has not moved. A little dust in the light. The letter is still flat at the back of the desk, separate. The edges of the older leaves. No figure on any edge. His thumb is near them and not on them.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Visible/present in Read the foot of the leaf while the light held
